findings.passage: But a ‘yes’ vote would amend the Wisconsin Constitution to include this requirement, which will further protect the integrity of the voting system from our leftist-activist WI Supreme Court.
findings.note: From his column on the voter ID constitutional amendment (Senate Joint Resolution 2, April 1 2025 ballot). He says a yes vote puts the photo ID rule in the state constitution and protects the voting system.

findings.passage: I believe this constitutional amendment will also increase future voter turnout.
findings.note: Same column. He says the amendment will raise turnout and cites turnout figures from 2012 and 2024.

findings.passage: All democratic forms of government depend on citizens having faith in the electoral process, and in my opinion, it is necessary to verify those who come to the polls are eligible to vote in order to protect the voting system of Wisconsin and our rights as citizens.
findings.note: Same column. He says voters at the polls should be verified as eligible, to protect public confidence in the system.
